name: Weebit Nano Limited
summary: Weebit Nano Limited engages in the development of non-volatile memory using a resistive random access memory technology based on fab-friendly materials in South Korea and the United States. It offers its products to aerospace and defense, IoT devices, secure devices, edge artificial intelligence, automotive, data center, neuromorphic computing, data logging, and medical devices industries. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
